verdict.rationale: Stripe's card-create API supports physical cards that Stripe itself prints and ships, so the ops user does not manage a card manufacturer. The docs also describe configuring card appearance, such as adding a company logo. Missing for 10: bulk ordering, selectable shipping methods, shipment tracking, explicit API control of custom card art, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can order personalized physical cards through the API — custom card art, bulk orders, shipping methods and tracking — without managing a card manufacturer relationship myself

citations.quote: A physical card will be printed and shipped. It can be used at physical terminals.
Configure the appearance of your physical cards, such as by adding a company logo, and customize the accompanying content.
